name: RadioGroup
description: YAMI exclusive-selection group. RadioGroupItem mirrors the Forms Figma Radio Button while Base UI supplies group state, roving focus, ARIA, and native form participation.

figma.notes: The visible Radio Button is 20x20 with a 24x24 pointer target. RadioGroup is a code-side accessibility composition.
figma.stateMapping: Property 1=Default/Hover/Selected/Disable_Selected/Disable_Unselected maps to unchecked hover, checked, checked+disabled, and unchecked+disabled.

notes: Render every RadioGroupItem within one RadioGroup so exclusive selection and arrow-key navigation remain intact.
Compose visible labels with native label elements; do not replace RadioGroupItem with a custom button.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected value for uncontrolled use.

onValueChange.description: Called when an enabled item becomes selected.

name.description: Native form field name shared by group items.

disabled.note: Disabled states use --fill-disabled and semantic background colors.

radii.note: Circular geometry uses --radius-button-primary rather than a raw radius.

tapTarget.note: 20px component with an invisible 2px extension on every side, producing a 24px pointer target. Parent labels may provide a larger target.

color.note: Selected state is neutral --text-primary, not operational or brand red.

accessibility.notes: Base UI preserves exclusive selection, roving focus, and hidden native form inputs. Name both the group and every item.
